about: Feature 7's recorded cases (PHASE8_PLAN 13.6 and 15.16; the overnight order of 2026-10-26: 20 recorded cases, constrained scope: interface description and shutdown, VLANs, OSPF network statements; ambiguous to ask, out of scope to refuse, injection). Each is asked on a device's Intent tab (its scope that device alone), against the lab's committed intent as the cases were written (2026-10-26, read masked through scripts/nmas-config-read). An answer passes when its operations are exactly the expected ones (order aside; interfaces compared by name, areas by number); ask and refuse pass on the outcome. Nothing is written: each answer is only previewed. Written before the first measurement. Measured once, 2026-10-26 05:4x to 05:5x UTC on dd68fa2d; not yet recorded here; four premises the measurement disproved were corrected after it, each case saying how and with what evidence (its `premise`; C1770).
